title: 44. Reject stale queue acknowledgements

examples.explanation: Received at 0 and acknowledged at 4, before the deadline of 5.
Redelivered at 5 with token 2. The old token 1 fails. Token 2 succeeds.
The acknowledgement at 5 is too late (the deadline is 5), so the message stays pending.

hints: Visibility and acknowledgement are separate state properties.
Check both token equality and the exclusive deadline before accepting an ack.
